model.Macs_data_stack.stg_ga4_events.name: stg_ga4_events
model.Macs_data_stack.stg_ga4_events.description:
Staging model for GA4 web events. Extracts and flattens the RAW JSON column from the GA4
Snowflake connector into typed columns, with deduplication to ensure each event appears once.

SOURCE: ga4.analytics_304541120 (GA4 export via Snowflake connector)

TRANSFORMATIONS:
- JSON extraction: Flattens nested RAW JSON into typed columns for all event, user, device,
  geo, ecommerce, and traffic source fields
- Event parameters: Extracts key parameters (page_location, ga_session_id, quote_reference, etc.)
  from the event_params array into dedicated columns
- Session ID generation: Creates session_id by hashing user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id.
  For users who declined cookies (privacy_info_analytics_storage = 'No'), session_id is
  hashed from event_id instead, creating single-event sessions
- Deduplication: Uses QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() to keep only the latest version of each event
  when the same event appears in multiple ingestion batches
- Null handling: Converts '(not set)' values to NULL for cleaner downstream processing

FILTERING:
- platform = 'WEB' only (excludes app traffic)
- Excludes staging and internal hostnames (zendesk, staging environments, translation proxies)

GRAIN: One row per GA4 event.

app_info_firebase_app_id.name: app_info_firebase_app_id
app_info_firebase_app_id.description: The Firebase app ID associated with the Macs Adventure mobile app. Primarily null for web traffic.

app_info_id.name: app_info_id
app_info_id.description: The package name (Android) or bundle ID (iOS) of the Macs Adventure app. Null for web traffic.

app_info_install_source.name: app_info_install_source
app_info_install_source.description: The source from which the Macs Adventure app was installed (e.g., manual_install, com.android.vending). Null for web traffic.

app_info_install_store.name: app_info_install_store
app_info_install_store.description: The app store from which the Macs Adventure app was installed (e.g., App Store, Google Play). Null for web traffic.

app_info_version.name: app_info_version
app_info_version.description: The version of the Macs Adventure app. Null for web traffic.

batch_event_index.name: batch_event_index
batch_event_index.description: The index position of the event within its GA4 batch (0-based). Used with batch_ordering_id for precise event sequencing and deduplication.

batch_ordering_id.name: batch_ordering_id
batch_ordering_id.description: The monotonically increasing ID assigned to each GA4 batch. Combined with batch_event_index to establish deterministic event ordering.

batch_page_id.name: batch_page_id
batch_page_id.description: The page ID within the GA4 batch. Used internally by GA4 for batch processing - rarely needed for analysis.

cross_channel_campaign_id.name: cross_channel_campaign_id
cross_channel_campaign_id.description: Campaign ID as drawn from the cross-channel object on the GA4 event.

cross_channel_campaign_name.name: cross_channel_campaign_name
cross_channel_campaign_name.description: Campaign name as drawn from the cross-channel object on the GA4 event. Often blank...

cross_channel_medium.name: cross_channel_medium
cross_channel_medium.description: Channel medium as drawn from the cross-channel object on the GA4 event. Often blank...

cross_channel_primary_channel_group.name: cross_channel_primary_channel_group
cross_channel_primary_channel_group.description: Campaign primary channel group as drawn from the cross-channel object on the GA4 event. Typically (cross channel)

cross_channel_source.name: cross_channel_source
cross_channel_source.description: Channel source as drawn from the cross-channel object on the GA4 event. Often blank...

device_advertising_id.name: device_advertising_id
device_advertising_id.description: The device's advertising identifier (IDFA for iOS, GAID for Android). Often null due to user privacy settings and ATT framework. Null for web traffic.

device_browser.name: device_browser
device_browser.description: The browser used to access the website (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox). For web traffic, prefer device_web_info_browser which is more reliably populated.

device_browser_version.name: device_browser_version
device_browser_version.description: The version of the browser. For web traffic, prefer device_web_info_browser_version which is more reliably populated.

device_category.name: device_category
device_category.description: The device type used to browse the Macs Adventure website (desktop, mobile, tablet). Important for understanding how customers research and book trips across devices.

device_is_limited_ad_tracking.name: device_is_limited_ad_tracking
device_is_limited_ad_tracking.description: Boolean indicating whether the user has enabled limited ad tracking (LAT) on their device. When true, device_advertising_id is unavailable.

device_language.name: device_language
device_language.description: The language setting of the user's device. Useful for identifying market alignment (e.g., German-language users for Abenteuer Wege).

device_mobile_brand_name.name: device_mobile_brand_name
device_mobile_brand_name.description: The brand of the mobile device (e.g., Apple, Samsung, Google). Null for desktop/web traffic.

device_mobile_marketing_name.name: device_mobile_marketing_name
device_mobile_marketing_name.description: The consumer-facing marketing name of the mobile device (e.g., iPhone 14 Pro, Galaxy S23). Null for desktop/web traffic.

device_mobile_model_name.name: device_mobile_model_name
device_mobile_model_name.description: The internal model identifier of the mobile device. Null for desktop/web traffic.

device_mobile_os_hardware_model.name: device_mobile_os_hardware_model
device_mobile_os_hardware_model.description: The hardware model identifier reported by the device's operating system (e.g., iPhone13,2). More granular than device_mobile_model_name.

device_operating_system.name: device_operating_system
device_operating_system.description: The operating system of the device (e.g., iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux).

device_operating_system_version.name: device_operating_system_version
device_operating_system_version.description: The version of the device's operating system (e.g., '14.5' for iOS, '10' for Windows).

device_time_zone_offset_seconds.name: device_time_zone_offset_seconds
device_time_zone_offset_seconds.description: The user's time zone offset from UTC in seconds (e.g., 3600 for UTC+1, -18000 for UTC-5). Useful for localising event times to user's perspective.

device_vendor_id.name: device_vendor_id
device_vendor_id.description: The iOS Identifier for Vendor (IDFV). Null for Android and web traffic.

device_web_info_browser.name: device_web_info_browser
device_web_info_browser.description: The browser name from web-specific device information. Preferred over device_browser for web traffic as it is more reliably populated.

device_web_info_browser_version.name: device_web_info_browser_version
device_web_info_browser_version.description: The browser version from web-specific device information. Preferred over device_browser_version for web traffic.

device_web_info_hostname.name: device_web_info_hostname
device_web_info_hostname.description: The hostname of the Macs Adventure website (e.g., macsadventure.com, abenteuer-wege.de) where the event occurred.

ecommerce_purchase_revenue.name: ecommerce_purchase_revenue
ecommerce_purchase_revenue.description: The trip booking revenue in the transaction's local currency (GBP, USD, EUR, AUD).

ecommerce_purchase_revenue_in_usd.name: ecommerce_purchase_revenue_in_usd
ecommerce_purchase_revenue_in_usd.description: The trip booking revenue converted to USD for cross-market comparison (UK, US, Germany, Australia).

ecommerce_refund_value.name: ecommerce_refund_value
ecommerce_refund_value.description: The refund amount for cancelled trip bookings.

ecommerce_refund_value_in_usd.name: ecommerce_refund_value_in_usd
ecommerce_refund_value_in_usd.description: The refund amount converted to USD for cross-market reporting.

ecommerce_shipping_value.name: ecommerce_shipping_value
ecommerce_shipping_value.description: Shipping/delivery charges associated with the booking (e.g., luggage transfer fees, document delivery).

ecommerce_tax_value.name: ecommerce_tax_value
ecommerce_tax_value.description: Tax amount associated with the trip booking.

ecommerce_total_item_quantity.name: ecommerce_total_item_quantity
ecommerce_total_item_quantity.description: The total number of items in the transaction (e.g., number of travellers, add-on services).

ecommerce_transaction_id.name: ecommerce_transaction_id
ecommerce_transaction_id.description: The unique transaction identifier for the purchase. Maps to booking_ref for linking GA4 frontend events to vSourz backend booking data.

ecommerce_unique_items.name: ecommerce_unique_items
ecommerce_unique_items.description: The number of distinct item types in the transaction (e.g., trip + extras like travel insurance).

engagement_time_msec.name: engagement_time_msec
engagement_time_msec.description: The time in milliseconds that the page or app was in the foreground and actively engaged. Accumulated across the session for total engagement time calculations.

entrances.name: entrances
entrances.description: Flag indicating whether this event was a session entrance (value of 1) or not (null). Used to identify landing page events and calculate entrance rates.

event_bundle_sequence_id.name: event_bundle_sequence_id
event_bundle_sequence_id.description: The sequential ID of the event bundle for ordering events within the same upload batch.

event_date.name: event_date
event_date.description: The calendar date when the event occurred. Used for daily reporting and trend analysis.

event_dimensions_hostname.name: event_dimensions_hostname
event_dimensions_hostname.description: The website hostname where the event was captured. Duplicates device_web_info_hostname - prefer device_web_info_hostname for consistency.

event_id.name: event_id
event_id.description: Surrogate key for the event, generated by hashing event_timestamp, user_pseudo_id, event_name, and event_bundle_sequence_id. Primary key for event-level analysis.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: The GA4 event name describing the user action (e.g., 'page_view', 'tour_form_submit', 'purchase', 'begin_checkout'). Key events for Macs include enquiry submissions and booking completions.

event_params.name: event_params
event_params.description: Semi-structured VARIANT column containing event-specific parameters as key-value pairs. Access values using event_params:key_name::datatype syntax in Snowflake.

event_previous_timestamp.name: event_previous_timestamp
event_previous_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the user's previous event in microseconds since epoch. Null for the first event in a user's history. Useful for calculating inter-event timing.

event_scope_campaign.name: event_scope_campaign
event_scope_campaign.description: The UTM campaign name (utm_campaign) captured from the URL at event time. Raw value from collected_traffic_source before any attribution logic is applied.

event_scope_campaign_id.name: event_scope_campaign_id
event_scope_campaign_id.description: The UTM campaign ID (utm_id) captured from the URL at event time. Raw value from collected_traffic_source before any attribution logic is applied.

event_scope_content.name: event_scope_content
event_scope_content.description: The UTM content parameter (utm_content) captured from the URL at event time.

event_scope_dclid.name: event_scope_dclid
event_scope_dclid.description: Display Click ID captured at event time from the URL. Automatically appended when users click Google Display Network ads.

event_scope_gclid.name: event_scope_gclid
event_scope_gclid.description: Google Click ID captured at event time from the URL. Automatically appended when users click Google Ads, enabling conversion tracking and attribution.

event_scope_medium.name: event_scope_medium
event_scope_medium.description: The UTM medium parameter (utm_medium) captured from the URL at event time (e.g., 'cpc', 'organic', 'email', 'referral'). Raw value before attribution logic.

event_scope_source.name: event_scope_source
event_scope_source.description: The UTM source parameter (utm_source) captured from the URL at event time (e.g., 'google', 'facebook', 'newsletter'). Raw value before attribution logic.

event_scope_srsltid.name: event_scope_srsltid
event_scope_srsltid.description: Search Result Source Listing ID captured at event time. Appended by Google when users click on product listings or organic results from Google Merchant Center.

event_scope_term.name: event_scope_term
event_scope_term.description: The UTM term parameter (utm_term) captured from the URL at event time. Typically used for paid search keyword tracking.

event_server_timestamp_offset.name: event_server_timestamp_offset
event_server_timestamp_offset.description: The offset in microseconds between the client event timestamp and server receipt time. Large positive values may indicate offline browsing; negative values suggest clock drift.

event_timestamp.name: event_timestamp
event_timestamp.description: The timestamp when the event occurred in microseconds since Unix epoch (UTC). Primary timestamp for event ordering. Convert to timestamp using TO_TIMESTAMP(event_timestamp, 6).

first_touch_campaign.name: first_touch_campaign
first_touch_campaign.description: The campaign from the user's very first visit to Macs Adventure (user acquisition). NOT for marketing attribution - use session_campaign instead. Useful for understanding which campaigns acquire new users.

first_touch_medium.name: first_touch_medium
first_touch_medium.description: The medium from the user's very first visit (user acquisition). NOT for marketing attribution - use session_medium instead.

first_touch_source.name: first_touch_source
first_touch_source.description: The source from the user's very first visit (user acquisition). NOT for marketing attribution - use session_source instead.

ga_session_id.name: ga_session_id
ga_session_id.description: The GA4 session identifier (integer). Not globally unique - must be combined with user_pseudo_id to create a unique session key. Extracted from event_params.ga_session_id.

ga_session_number.name: ga_session_number
ga_session_number.description: The sequential session count for this user (1 = first session, 2 = second session, etc.). Higher numbers indicate returning visitors researching trips across multiple sessions.

geo_city.name: geo_city
geo_city.description: The city from which the user accessed the Macs Adventure website, based on IP geolocation.

geo_continent.name: geo_continent
geo_continent.description: The continent from which the user accessed the website. Useful for high-level geographic segmentation.

geo_country.name: geo_country
geo_country.description: The country from which the user accessed the website. Critical for market segmentation (UK, US, Germany, Australia, etc.) and aligning users to business units.

geo_metro.name: geo_metro
geo_metro.description: The metropolitan area (DMA in US) from which the user accessed the website.

geo_region.name: geo_region
geo_region.description: The region/state/province from which the user accessed the website.

geo_sub_continent.name: geo_sub_continent
geo_sub_continent.description: The sub-continental region from which the user accessed the website (e.g., Northern Europe, Western Europe).

google_ads_account_name.name: google_ads_account_name
google_ads_account_name.description: The Google Ads account name from session last-click attribution. Identifies which Macs Adventure Google Ads account drove the session.

google_ads_ad_group_id.name: google_ads_ad_group_id
google_ads_ad_group_id.description: The Google Ads ad group identifier from session last-click attribution. Used for granular ad group performance analysis.

google_ads_ad_group_name.name: google_ads_ad_group_name
google_ads_ad_group_name.description: The Google Ads ad group name from session last-click attribution. Provides human-readable context for ad group performance reporting.

google_ads_campaign_id.name: google_ads_campaign_id
google_ads_campaign_id.description: The Google Ads campaign identifier from session last-click attribution. Used for joining to Google Ads reporting data.

google_ads_campaign_name.name: google_ads_campaign_name
google_ads_campaign_name.description: The Google Ads campaign name from session last-click attribution. Provides human-readable campaign context for attribution analysis.

google_ads_customer_id.name: google_ads_customer_id
google_ads_customer_id.description: The Google Ads customer (account) identifier from session last-click attribution. The top-level account ID in the Google Ads hierarchy.

ignore_referrer.name: ignore_referrer
ignore_referrer.description: Boolean flag indicating the page referrer is an internal Macs Adventure URL and should not be treated as a referral source. Used to filter out self-referrals in attribution.

ingestion_complete.name: ingestion_complete
ingestion_complete.description: Boolean flag indicating whether GA4 data ingestion for this date is complete. False indicates partial data that may be updated in subsequent runs.

items.name: items
items.description: Semi-structured VARIANT array containing ecommerce item details (item_id, item_name, price, quantity, etc.). Only populated for ecommerce events like view_item, add_to_cart, purchase.

link_domain.name: link_domain
link_domain.description: The domain of a link clicked by the user. Captured on click events to track internal & external navigation

link_url.name: link_url
link_url.description: The full URL of a link clicked by the user. Captured on click events to track internal & external destinations.

page_location.name: page_location
page_location.description: The full URL of the page where the event occurred. Useful for understanding which tour pages, destinations, or content drive engagement and conversions.

page_referrer.name: page_referrer
page_referrer.description: The URL of the page that referred the user to the current page. Null if ignore_referrer is true (internal navigation) or if no referrer was captured.

page_title.name: page_title
page_title.description: The HTML title of the page where the event occurred. Provides context about the content the user was viewing (e.g., tour names, destination guides).

percent_scrolled.name: percent_scrolled
percent_scrolled.description: The percentage of the page vertically scrolled by the user (e.g., 25, 50, 75, 90). Captured on scroll events to measure content engagement depth.

enquiry_id.name: enquiry_id
enquiry_id.description: Primary key for enquiries, foreign key to stg_enquiries from bookings.

platform.name: platform
platform.description: The platform where the event was captured: 'WEB' for website, 'IOS' or 'ANDROID' for mobile apps.

privacy_info_ads_storage.name: privacy_info_ads_storage
privacy_info_ads_storage.description: Whether the user has consented to ads storage (cookie consent). Affects remarketing and conversion tracking capabilities.

privacy_info_analytics_storage.name: privacy_info_analytics_storage
privacy_info_analytics_storage.description: Whether the user has consented to analytics storage (cookie consent). Affects the completeness of user journey tracking.

privacy_info_uses_transient_token.name: privacy_info_uses_transient_token
privacy_info_uses_transient_token.description: Boolean indicating whether GA4 is using a transient token instead of cookies due to consent restrictions. When true, user_pseudo_id changes each session.

product.name: product
product.description: The tour product category associated with the event (e.g., 'walking', 'cycling', 'pilgrimage'). Extracted from event_params on ecommerce events (view_item, add_to_cart, purchase). Used for product-level performance analysis and aligning conversions to trip types.

quote_reference.name: quote_reference
quote_reference.description: The unique quote/booking reference number that links GA4 frontend events to vSourz backend booking data. Critical for connecting marketing attribution to actual trip bookings and revenue.

quote_uuid.name: quote_uuid
quote_uuid.description: The universally unique identifier for the quote, used as an alternative key for joining to vSourz booking data.

run_id.name: run_id
run_id.description: The unique identifier of the data ingestion run that loaded this record. Used for data lineage and debugging ingestion issues.

search_term.name: search_term
search_term.description: The search query that brought the user to the site from a search engine. Frequently null as most search engines (including Google) encrypt search terms for privacy. Only reliably populated for paid search campaigns with keyword tracking enabled.

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.description: Surrogate key for the session, generated by hashing user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id. For users who declined analytics cookies, each event gets a unique session_id (hashed from event_id), meaning these 'sessions' contain only one event and cannot be aggregated into true session behaviour. See stg_ga4_events model description for generation logic.

session_scope_campaign_id.name: session_scope_campaign_id
session_scope_campaign_id.description: The campaign ID from GA4's session-level last-click attribution (session_traffic_source_last_click). Represents the manually-tagged campaign ID for the session.

session_scope_campaign_name.name: session_scope_campaign_name
session_scope_campaign_name.description: The campaign name from GA4's session-level last-click attribution (session_traffic_source_last_click). Represents the manually-tagged campaign name for the session.

session_scope_content.name: session_scope_content
session_scope_content.description: The UTM content parameter from GA4's session-level last-click attribution. Used for ad variation and A/B test tracking at session level.

session_scope_medium.name: session_scope_medium
session_scope_medium.description: The medium from GA4's session-level last-click attribution (session_traffic_source_last_click). Represents the manually-tagged medium for the session.

session_scope_source.name: session_scope_source
session_scope_source.description: The source from GA4's session-level last-click attribution (session_traffic_source_last_click). Represents the manually-tagged source for the session.

session_scope_term.name: session_scope_term
session_scope_term.description: The UTM term parameter from GA4's session-level last-click attribution. Used for paid search keyword tracking at session level.

source_table_date.name: source_table_date
source_table_date.description: The date partition of the source GA4 export table. Used for incremental processing and data freshness tracking.

stream_id.name: stream_id
stream_id.description: The GA4 data stream identifier. Different streams may represent different Macs Adventure websites (UK, US, Germany) or platforms.

user_first_touch_timestamp.name: user_first_touch_timestamp
user_first_touch_timestamp.description: The timestamp (microseconds since epoch) of the user's very first interaction with Macs Adventure. Used for cohort analysis and customer lifetime calculations.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.description: The authenticated user identifier from the vSource backend system. Set when users log in or complete bookings. Critical for cross-session identity resolution and joining GA4 events to backend booking data. See int_session_identities model description for identity resolution logic.

user_properties.name: user_properties
user_properties.description: Semi-structured VARIANT column containing user-scoped properties set via gtag or Firebase SDK. Access values using user_properties:property_name:value::datatype syntax.

user_pseudo_id.name: user_pseudo_id
user_pseudo_id.description: The anonymous GA4 client identifier (cookie-based). Persists across sessions on the same device/browser but cannot track users across devices. Linked to user_id when users authenticate. See int_session_identities model description for identity resolution logic.

model.Macs_data_stack.stg_ga4_events.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        unique_key='event_id',
        incremental_strategy='delete+insert',
        cluster_by=['event_date'],
        snowflake_warehouse = set_warehouse_size('M') if target.name in ['dev', 'ci'] else set_warehouse_size('XL'),
    )
}}

with source as (

    select *
    from {{ source('ga4', 'analytics_304541120') }}

    where 1 = 1
    {% if target.name == 'dev' %}
    and to_date(raw:event_date::string, 'YYYYMMDD') >= (current_date() - interval '{{ var("dev_data_limit") }}')
    {% endif %}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    and to_date(raw:event_date::string, 'YYYYMMDD')
        >= ((select max(existing_tab.event_date) from {{ this }} as existing_tab) - interval '{{ var("incremental_load_lookback_window") }}')
    {% endif %}

),

-- Extract all fields from the RAW JSON column
flattened as (
    select
        -- Generate surrogate key for event_id
        {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['raw:event_timestamp', 'raw:user_pseudo_id', 'raw:event_name', 'raw:event_bundle_sequence_id']) }} as event_id,

        -- Core event fields
        to_date(raw:event_date::string, 'YYYYMMDD') as event_date,
        to_timestamp(raw:event_timestamp::number / 1000000) as event_timestamp,
        raw:event_name::string as event_name,
        raw:event_params as event_params,
        to_timestamp(raw:event_previous_timestamp::number / 1000000) as event_previous_timestamp,
        raw:event_bundle_sequence_id::number as event_bundle_sequence_id,
        raw:event_server_timestamp_offset::number as event_server_timestamp_offset,
        -- User fields
        raw:user_id::string as user_id,
        raw:user_pseudo_id::string as user_pseudo_id,

        -- Privacy info
        raw:privacy_info:analytics_storage::string as privacy_info_analytics_storage,
        raw:privacy_info:ads_storage::string as privacy_info_ads_storage,
        raw:privacy_info:uses_transient_token::string as privacy_info_uses_transient_token,

        -- User properties
        raw:user_properties as user_properties,
        to_timestamp(raw:user_first_touch_timestamp::number / 1000000) as user_first_touch_timestamp,
        raw:user_ltv:revenue::float as user_ltv_revenue,
        raw:user_ltv:currency::string as user_ltv_currency,

        -- Device fields
        raw:device:category::string as device_category,
        raw:device:mobile_brand_name::string as device_mobile_brand_name,
        raw:device:mobile_model_name::string as device_mobile_model_name,
        raw:device:mobile_marketing_name::string as device_mobile_marketing_name,
        raw:device:mobile_os_hardware_model::string as device_mobile_os_hardware_model,
        raw:device:operating_system::string as device_operating_system,
        raw:device:operating_system_version::string as device_operating_system_version,
        raw:device:vendor_id::string as device_vendor_id,
        raw:device:advertising_id::string as device_advertising_id,
        raw:device:language::string as device_language,
        raw:device:is_limited_ad_tracking::string as device_is_limited_ad_tracking,
        raw:device:time_zone_offset_seconds::number as device_time_zone_offset_seconds,
        raw:device:browser::string as device_browser,
        raw:device:browser_version::string as device_browser_version,
        raw:device:web_info:browser::string as device_web_info_browser,
        raw:device:web_info:browser_version::string as device_web_info_browser_version,
        raw:device:web_info:hostname::string as device_web_info_hostname,

        -- Geo fields
        raw:geo:continent::string as geo_continent,
        raw:geo:country::string as geo_country,
        raw:geo:region::string as geo_region,
        raw:geo:city::string as geo_city,
        raw:geo:sub_continent::string as geo_sub_continent,
        raw:geo:metro::string as geo_metro,

        -- App info
        raw:app_info:id::string as app_info_id,
        raw:app_info:version::string as app_info_version,
        raw:app_info:install_store::string as app_info_install_store,
        raw:app_info:firebase_app_id::string as app_info_firebase_app_id,
        raw:app_info:install_source::string as app_info_install_source,

        -- Stream and platform
        raw:stream_id::string as stream_id,
        raw:platform::string as platform,

        -- Event dimensions
        raw:event_dimensions:hostname::string as event_dimensions_hostname,

        -- Ecommerce fields
        raw:ecommerce:total_item_quantity::number as ecommerce_total_item_quantity,
        raw:ecommerce:purchase_revenue_in_usd::float as ecommerce_purchase_revenue_in_usd,
        raw:ecommerce:purchase_revenue::float as ecommerce_purchase_revenue,
        raw:ecommerce:refund_value_in_usd::float as ecommerce_refund_value_in_usd,
        raw:ecommerce:refund_value::float as ecommerce_refund_value,
        raw:ecommerce:shipping_value_in_usd::float as ecommerce_shipping_value_in_usd,
        raw:ecommerce:shipping_value::float as ecommerce_shipping_value,
        raw:ecommerce:tax_value_in_usd::float as ecommerce_tax_value_in_usd,
        raw:ecommerce:tax_value::float as ecommerce_tax_value,
        raw:ecommerce:unique_items::number as ecommerce_unique_items,
        nullif(raw:ecommerce:transaction_id::string, '(not set)') as ecommerce_transaction_id,

        -- Items array
        raw:items as items,

        -- First-touch traffic source (user acquisition - when user FIRST visited)
        raw:traffic_source:name::string as first_touch_campaign,
        raw:traffic_source:medium::string as first_touch_medium,
        raw:traffic_source:source::string as first_touch_source,

        -- Session traffic source (current session UTMs)
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_campaign_id::string as event_scope_campaign_id,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_campaign_name::string as event_scope_campaign,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_source::string as event_scope_source,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_medium::string as event_scope_medium,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_term::string as event_scope_term,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:manual_content::string as event_scope_content,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:gclid::string as event_scope_gclid,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:dclid::string as event_scope_dclid,
        raw:collected_traffic_source:srsltid::string as event_scope_srsltid,

        -- Session traffic source last click (manual campaign)
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:campaign_id::string as session_scope_campaign_id,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:campaign_name::string as session_scope_campaign_name,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:source::string as session_scope_source,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:medium::string as session_scope_medium,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:term::string as session_scope_term,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:manual_campaign:content::string as session_scope_content,

        -- Session traffic source last click (cross-channel campaign - GA4's auto-classified source)
        -- This is populated by GA4 even when google_ads_campaign is null (e.g., AbenteuerWege)
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:cross_channel_campaign:source::string as cross_channel_source,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:cross_channel_campaign:medium::string as cross_channel_medium,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:cross_channel_campaign:campaign_id::string as cross_channel_campaign_id,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:cross_channel_campaign:campaign_name::string as cross_channel_campaign_name,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:cross_channel_campaign:primary_channel_group::string as cross_channel_primary_channel_group,

        -- Session traffic source last click (Google Ads campaign)
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:customer_id::string as google_ads_customer_id,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:account_name::string as google_ads_account_name,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:campaign_id::string as google_ads_campaign_id,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:campaign_name::string as google_ads_campaign_name,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:ad_group_id::string as google_ads_ad_group_id,
        raw:session_traffic_source_last_click:google_ads_campaign:ad_group_name::string as google_ads_ad_group_name,

        -- Batch fields
        raw:batch_event_index::number as batch_event_index,
        raw:batch_ordering_id::number as batch_ordering_id,
        raw:batch_page_id::number as batch_page_id,

        -- Metadata from ingestion
        run_id,
        source_table_date,
        ingestion_complete

    from source

),

-- Extract key event parameters for easier querying
extract_properties as (
    select
        flattened.event_id,
        flattened.event_name,
        extracted.value:key::string as event_property,
        extracted.value:value:string_value::string as event_property_value_string,
        extracted.value:value:int_value::number as event_property_value_int
    from
        flattened,
        lateral flatten(input => flattened.event_params) as extracted
),

dedupe_to_event_granularity as (
    select
        event_id,
        event_name,
        max(case when event_property = 'page_location' then event_property_value_string end) as page_location,
        max(case when event_property = 'page_title' then event_property_value_string end) as page_title,
        max(case when event_property = 'ga_session_id' then event_property_value_int end) as ga_session_id,
        max(case when event_property = 'ga_session_number' then event_property_value_int end) as ga_session_number,
        max(case when event_property = 'quoteUUID' then event_property_value_string end) as quote_uuid,
        max(case when event_property = 'quoteReference' then event_property_value_string end) as quote_reference,
        max(case when event_property = 'product' then event_property_value_string end) as product,
        max(case when event_property = 'page_referrer' then event_property_value_string end) as page_referrer,
        max(case when event_property = 'ignore_referrer' then event_property_value_string end) as ignore_referrer,
        max(case when event_property = 'engagement_time_msec' then event_property_value_int end) as engagement_time_msec,
        max(case when event_property = 'entrances' then event_property_value_int end) as entrances,
        max(case when event_property = 'search_term' then event_property_value_string end) as search_term,
        max(case when event_property = 'link_url' then event_property_value_string end) as link_url,
        max(case when event_property = 'link_domain' then event_property_value_string end) as link_domain,
        max(case when event_property = 'percent_scrolled' then event_property_value_int end) as percent_scrolled,
        max(case when event_property = 'gad_campaignid' then event_property_value_string end) as gad_campaign_id,
        max(case when event_property = 'enquiry_id' then event_property_value_int::string end) as enquiry_id
    from
        extract_properties
    group by all
),

-- Deduplicate events that may appear in multiple ingestion runs
deduplicated as (
    select
        flattened.*,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.page_location,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.page_title,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.ga_session_id,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.ga_session_number,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.quote_uuid,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.quote_reference,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.product,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.page_referrer,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.ignore_referrer,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.engagement_time_msec,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.entrances,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.search_term,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.link_url,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.link_domain,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.percent_scrolled,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.gad_campaign_id,
        dedupe_to_event_granularity.enquiry_id
    from flattened
    left join dedupe_to_event_granularity
        on flattened.event_id = dedupe_to_event_granularity.event_id
        and flattened.event_name = dedupe_to_event_granularity.event_name
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by flattened.event_id
        order by flattened.source_table_date desc
    ) = 1
),

clean_up as (
    select
        case
            when privacy_info_analytics_storage = 'No' then {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['event_id']) }}
            else {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['user_pseudo_id', 'ga_session_id']) }}
        end as session_id,
        event_id,
        event_date,
        event_timestamp,
        event_name,
        event_params,
        event_previous_timestamp,
        event_bundle_sequence_id,
        event_server_timestamp_offset,
        user_id,
        user_pseudo_id,
        privacy_info_analytics_storage,
        privacy_info_ads_storage,
        privacy_info_uses_transient_token,
        user_properties,
        user_first_touch_timestamp,
        device_category,
        device_mobile_brand_name,
        device_mobile_model_name,
        device_mobile_marketing_name,
        device_mobile_os_hardware_model,
        device_operating_system,
        device_operating_system_version,
        device_vendor_id,
        device_advertising_id,
        device_language,
        device_is_limited_ad_tracking,
        device_time_zone_offset_seconds,
        device_browser,
        device_browser_version,
        device_web_info_browser,
        device_web_info_browser_version,
        device_web_info_hostname,
        geo_continent,
        geo_country,
        geo_region,
        geo_city,
        geo_sub_continent,
        geo_metro,
        app_info_id,
        app_info_version,
        app_info_install_store,
        app_info_firebase_app_id,
        app_info_install_source,

        stream_id,
        platform,
        event_dimensions_hostname,
        ecommerce_total_item_quantity,
        ecommerce_purchase_revenue_in_usd,
        ecommerce_purchase_revenue,
        ecommerce_refund_value_in_usd,
        ecommerce_refund_value,
        ecommerce_shipping_value_in_usd,
        ecommerce_shipping_value,
        ecommerce_tax_value_in_usd,
        ecommerce_tax_value,
        ecommerce_unique_items,
        ecommerce_transaction_id,
        items,

        -- Event Scope traffic source (drawn from UTMs)

        event_scope_gclid,
        event_scope_dclid,
        event_scope_srsltid,

        {% set placeholder_strings_to_remove = ['(not set)',
                                                '(organic)',
                                                '(referral)',
                                                'Data Not Available',
                                                '(direct)',
                                                '(not provided)',
                                                '(cross-network)',
                                                '(none)'] %}

        -- First-touch (user acquisition) - nullify placeholder values
        first_touch_campaign,
        {{ nullif_values('first_touch_medium', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as first_touch_medium,
        {{ nullif_values('first_touch_source', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as first_touch_source,

        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_campaign_id', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_campaign_id,
        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_campaign', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_campaign,
        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_term', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_term,
        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_source', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_source,
        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_medium', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_medium,
        {{ nullif_values('event_scope_content', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as event_scope_content,

        -- Session traffic source last click (manual campaign)
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_campaign_id', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_campaign_id,
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_campaign_name', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_campaign_name,
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_source', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_source,
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_medium', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_medium,
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_term', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_term,
        {{ nullif_values('session_scope_content', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as session_scope_content,

        -- Session traffic source last click (cross-channel campaign - GA4's auto-classified source)
        {{ nullif_values('cross_channel_source', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as cross_channel_source,
        {{ nullif_values('cross_channel_medium', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as cross_channel_medium,
        {{ nullif_values('cross_channel_campaign_id', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as cross_channel_campaign_id,
        {{ nullif_values('cross_channel_campaign_name', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as cross_channel_campaign_name,
        {{ nullif_values('cross_channel_primary_channel_group', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as cross_channel_primary_channel_group,

        -- Session traffic source last click (Google Ads campaign)
        -- Use gad_campaign_id as fallback when google_ads_campaign_id is not available
        google_ads_customer_id,
        google_ads_account_name,
        coalesce(nullif(google_ads_campaign_id, '(not set)'), gad_campaign_id) as google_ads_campaign_id,
        {{ nullif_values('google_ads_campaign_name', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as google_ads_campaign_name,
        {{ nullif_values('google_ads_ad_group_id', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as google_ads_ad_group_id,
        {{ nullif_values('google_ads_ad_group_name', placeholder_strings_to_remove) }} as google_ads_ad_group_name,

        batch_event_index,
        batch_ordering_id,
        batch_page_id,

        -- Extracted event properties
        page_location,
        page_title,
        ga_session_id,
        ga_session_number,
        quote_uuid,
        quote_reference,
        product,
        page_referrer,
        ignore_referrer,
        engagement_time_msec,
        entrances,
        search_term,
        link_url,
        link_domain,
        percent_scrolled,
        -- Blank out enquiry_id for generate_lead events from 2026-02-04 onwards.
        -- Before this date, generate_lead was the ONLY event capturing enquiry_ids.
        -- From 2026-02-04, specific event types (Tour_brochure, Enquire_tour, etc.) also
        -- capture enquiry_ids, causing duplicates. We preserve the specific events as they
        -- provide more granular event type information.
        -- Also null out:
        --   - enquiry_id = 0 (invalid placeholder values)
        --   - session_start events (GA4 system event that shouldn't have enquiry_ids)
        case
            when enquiry_id = 0 then null
            when event_name = 'session_start' then null
            when event_name = 'generate_lead' and event_date >= '2026-02-04' then null
            else enquiry_id
        end as enquiry_id,

        -- Metadata
        run_id,
        source_table_date,
        ingestion_complete

    from deduplicated
    where platform = 'WEB'
    and device_web_info_hostname not in (
        'macsadventureuk.zendesk.com',
        'staging-myaccount.macsadventure.com',
        'staging-myaccountus.macsadventure.com',
        'www-macsadventure-com.translate.goog',
        'staging.abenteuerwege.de',
        'staging.macsadventure.com',
        'macsadventure.zendesk.com',
        'staging-booking.macsadventure.com',
        'staging-bookingus.macsadventure.com',
        'staging-buchung.abenteuerwege.de',
        'staging-meinkonto.abenteuerwege.de',
        'www-abenteuerwege-de.translate.goog',
        'macsadventure.local',
        'dev.macsadventure.com',
        'prod-booking.macsadventure.com',
        'prod.macsadventure.com'
    )
),

-- Patch in event_id <-> enquiry_id pairings as estimated through fuzzy matching.
patch_in_historic_enquiry_ids as (
    select
        clean_up.* exclude (enquiry_id),
        coalesce(clean_up.enquiry_id, patch.enquiry_id) as enquiry_id
    from clean_up
        left join {{ ref('fuzzy_matched_enquiries_to_events') }} as patch
            using (event_id)
),

-- Null out enquiry_id on duplicate events where the gap is <=30s (GA4 double-fire or slow-connection resubmit).
-- Gaps >30s are treated as genuine second submissions and both rows are preserved. (these shouldn't happen)
dedupe_enquiry_ids as (
    select
        * exclude (enquiry_id),
        iff(
            datediff('second', min(event_timestamp) over (partition by enquiry_id), max(event_timestamp) over (partition by enquiry_id)) <= 30
            and row_number() over (partition by enquiry_id order by event_timestamp, event_id) > 1,
            null,
            enquiry_id
        ) as enquiry_id
    from patch_in_historic_enquiry_ids
)

select * from dedupe_enquiry_ids

model.Macs_data_stack.dmn_bookings_versi.name: dmn_bookings_versioned
model.Macs_data_stack.dmn_bookings_versi.description:
Full SCD2 booking domain model with valid_to and customer type columns.
One row per (booking_id, valid_from).

Extends int_bookings_scd with:
  - valid_to: derived via lead(valid_from) over the version spine. NULL on the
    current (latest) version of each booking. Use COALESCE(valid_to, '9999-12-31')
    when filtering to a point-in-time.
  - prior_booking_count / is_first_booking / customer_type: joined from
    int_booking_customer_type_versioned, which computes these point-in-time
    via a temporal self-join across sibling bookings.

dmn_bookings is a simple select * exclude (valid_from, valid_to, version_number)
where valid_to is null over this model.

BACKDATED CORRECTION: A structural vSourz sync pattern produces ~30–70 affected bookings
per month-end. Bookings enter as Pending (booked_date = null), are synced on the last day
of month M, then transition to Provisional overnight — vSourz backfills booked_date =
last_day(M) but that change is only synced on day 1 of M+1. The first version with
booked_date set therefore has valid_from in M+1, making the booking invisible on any
month-end snapshot join. A synthetic row is added with valid_from = last_day(booked_date)
so all consumers see the booking correctly on the month-end snapshot. valid_to on the
synthetic row is capped at the next real valid_from to prevent overlap. The original M+1
row is preserved unchanged.

GRAIN: One row per (booking_id, valid_from). The unique_combination_of_columns test is
scoped to booking_ref is not null to exclude ghost rows.

brand.name: brand

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.description: Business unit name (Abenteuer Wege, Macs UK, Macs US).

cancellation_charges.name: cancellation_charges

cancellation_comments.name: cancellation_comments

cancellation_reason_description.description: Extended description of the cancellation reason

cancelled_date.description: Date when the booking was cancelled

cancelled_financial_year.name: cancelled_financial_year
cancelled_financial_year.description: Financial year when the booking was cancelled (December = Month 1 of next FY)

child_count.name: child_count

confirmed_financial_year.name: confirmed_financial_year
confirmed_financial_year.description: Financial year of confirmation (December = Month 1 of next FY)

contracting_business_unit.name: contracting_business_unit

currency_code.name: currency_code

customer_country.name: customer_country

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: Primary key from source system, foreign key to stg_customers

customer_ref.name: customer_ref
customer_ref.description: Customer reference (e.g., CUST434822). Human-readable business identifier for customers.

customer_type.description: New/Repeat customer classification based on prior non-cancelled bookings. New = first ever booking (prior_booking_count = 0); Repeat = any subsequent booking. Null when customer_id is null.

gross_margin_amount_eur.name: gross_margin_amount_eur
gross_margin_amount_eur.description: Gross margin amount converted to EUR via GBP

gross_margin_amount_gbp.name: gross_margin_amount_gbp

gross_margin_amount_usd.name: gross_margin_amount_usd
gross_margin_amount_usd.description: Gross margin amount converted to USD via GBP

ground_handler_cost_gbp.name: ground_handler_cost_gbp
ground_handler_cost_gbp.description: Ground handler/supplier cost converted to GBP

has_enquiry.description: Flag indicating whether this booking originated from an enquiry (true)

high_booking_status.name: high_booking_status
high_booking_status.description: Grouped booking status that collapses granular vSourz statuses into broad categories. Maps as follows: Provisional-New / Provisional / Provisional-Amendment → Provisional; Confirmed / Confirmed-Completed / Confirmed-Amendment → Confirmed; Pending → Pending; Cancelled → Cancelled; Postponed → Postponed; Abandoned → Abandoned. model.Macs_data_stack.dmn_bookings_versi.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='table'
    )
}}

-- Extends int_bookings_scd with valid_to, customer type, and loyalty_grouping.
-- Also synthesises a backdated row for ~30–70 bookings per month-end that would
-- otherwise be invisible on month-end snapshot joins — see dmn_bookings_versioned.yml
-- for the full explanation.
with with_valid_to as (

    select
        *,
        lead(valid_from) over (
            partition by booking_id order by valid_from
        ) as valid_to
    from {{ ref('int_bookings_scd') }}

),

with_customer_type as (

    select
        with_valid_to.*,
        -- Bookings with no customer_id won't match the join (ct only covers customer_id is not null).
        -- Default prior_booking_count to 0 and is_first_booking to true for anonymous bookings.
        coalesce(ct.prior_booking_count, 0) as prior_booking_count,
        coalesce(ct.is_first_booking, true) as is_first_booking,
        ct.customer_type,
        case coalesce(ct.prior_booking_count, 0)
            when 0 then '1. New Customer'
            when 1 then '2. First Timers'
            when 2 then '3. Repeat'
            when 3 then '4. Frequent'
            when 4 then '4. Frequent'
            else '5. Loyal'
        end as loyalty_grouping
    from with_valid_to
    left join {{ ref('int_booking_customer_type_versioned') }} as ct
        on with_valid_to.booking_id = ct.booking_id
        and with_valid_to.valid_from = ct.valid_from

),

next_real_valid_from as (

    select
        booking_id,
        min(valid_from) as next_real_valid_from
    from with_customer_type
    where valid_from::date > last_day(booked_date::date)
    group by booking_id

),

synthetic_month_end_rows as (

    select
        f.* exclude (valid_from, valid_to),
        last_day(f.booked_date::date)::timestamp_ntz as valid_from,
        nrvf.next_real_valid_from as valid_to
    from with_customer_type as f
    inner join next_real_valid_from as nrvf
        on f.booking_id = nrvf.booking_id
    where
        f.booked_date::date = last_day(f.booked_date::date)
        and f.valid_from::date > last_day(f.booked_date::date)
        and f.modified_date::date <= last_day(f.booked_date::date)
    qualify row_number() over (partition by f.booking_id order by f.valid_from) = 1

),

-- Union the real and synthetic rows before enrichment
unioned as (

    select * from with_customer_type
    union all by name
    select * from synthetic_month_end_rows

),

-- Tour dimension: activity_category, tour_range, and corrected tour_country
tours as (

    select
        tour_code,
        activity_category,
        tour_range,
        tour_country,
        tour_country_code
    from {{ ref('dmn_tours') }}

),

-- Customer enrichment: customer_country (for Fivetran bookings) and date_of_birth
-- (for marketing_segment age calculation)
customers as (

    select
        customer_id,
        customer_country,
        date_of_birth
    from {{ ref('int_customers_enriched') }}

),

final as (

    select
        unioned.* exclude (customer_country),

        -- customer_country: legacy rows carry it directly; Fivetran rows resolve via customer join.
        -- ~2,100 recent bookings had null in the versioned model due to missing legacy row.
        coalesce(unioned.customer_country, customers.customer_country) as customer_country,

        -- Tour dimension fields (joined on tour_code)
        tours.activity_category,
        tours.tour_range,
        tours.tour_country,
        tours.tour_country_code,

        -- Marketing segment: derived from passenger count and customer age at booked_date.
        -- Age threshold for Young vs Older Couple is 50 years (matches Power BI stored proc).
        -- ~6.6% of 2-pax bookings have no DOB → 'Unknown Couple'.
        -- 0 or null passengers → 'Other (segment)'.
        case
            when unioned.total_passengers = 1
                then 'Solo'
            when unioned.total_passengers > 2
                then 'Adult Group'
            when unioned.total_passengers = 2
                and datediff('year', customers.date_of_birth, unioned.booked_date::date) < 50
                then 'Young Couple'
            when unioned.total_passengers = 2
                and datediff('year', customers.date_of_birth, unioned.booked_date::date) >= 50
                then 'Older Couple'
            when unioned.total_passengers = 2
                then 'Unknown Couple'
            else 'Other (segment)'
        end as marketing_segment

    from unioned
    left join tours
        on unioned.tour_code = tours.tour_code
    left join customers
        on unioned.customer_id = customers.customer_id

)

select * from final
